issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 07 does not join Gemeinde and Schwimmbad on the gemeindeschluessel. The problem requests the names of Gemeinden that have a "Freibad" and the names of the respective Freibäder (a one-to-many relation), but solution_repository/aufgabe07.sql only filters Schwimmbad.art='Freibad' and omits the join condition. This yields a Cartesian product of all Gemeinden with all Freibäder and therefore returns incorrect pairings (or too many rows), which contradicts the task and will confuse or mislead students.
issues.suggestedFix: In the solution, add the join condition between Gemeinde and Schwimmbad. For example: SELECT Gemeinde.name, Schwimmbad.name FROM Gemeinde, Schwimmbad WHERE Gemeinde.schluessel = Schwimmbad.gemeindeschluessel AND Schwimmbad.art = 'Freibad'; Alternatively use an explicit JOIN: SELECT g.name, s.name FROM Gemeinde g JOIN Schwimmbad s ON g.schluessel = s.gemeindeschluessel WHERE s.art = 'Freibad';
